note: Round-3 additions. Same schema as pdf_corpus_expanded_manifest.json. source_url is provenance, not a required fetch - the PDFs are committed under benchmarks/corpus/ with SHA256SUMS. n_expected counts the NAMED molecules the document draws that were catalogued; n_resolved counts those carrying a PubChem CID. est_structures is the total number of DRAWINGS on the page, which is much larger - precision is not reportable against a partial ground truth (see FINDINGS.md). est_run_hours_mixed is added in this round: est_run_hours_measured multiplies EVERY page by the 64 s figure-bearing rate, which understates any document with text-only pages.

accepted.title: CN 108503621 B, "Preparation method of vonoprazan fumarate", granted 2018-09-07 / published 2021-09-14 (CNIPA)
accepted.licence: Published CNIPA patent document, public record; same basis as the US and EP files in this corpus
accepted.drawing_style: Chinese-language granted patent. Body text is vector (iTextSharp) with the reaction schemes inserted as 150-ppi INDEXED RASTER clippings (largest 870x608) - a third patent PDF class, distinct from the US files' full-page 300-dpi CCITT rasters and EP0641330B1's 300-dpi CCITT clippings. Reagent labels on the arrows are Chinese
accepted.structure_pages: p1 abstract (chromatogram thumbnail); p2 claims scheme; p3 prior-art schemes; p4 compounds I-V + product; p6 the claimed route. pp10-11 are figures 1-4, four HPLC CHROMATOGRAMS with peak tables - non-structure figures inside a structure document. Text-only: pp5, 7, 8, 9
accepted.why: The non-English gap. Whole document is Chinese, so the LAYOUT and the in-scheme reagent text are language-dependent while the drawings are not - exactly the variable to isolate. Every drawing is a SPECIFIC compound (process patent, not a composition-of-matter Markush). Carries its own negative control in pp10-11. Also cross-links to both review articles, which draw vonoprazan too, so the same molecule appears in three drawing styles
accepted.caveat: Resolution: the clippings are 150 ppi at source, below the corpus's 300-dpi preference. Checked by extracting the p4 clipping: one molecule occupies ~290x200 source px, i.e. ~580x400 px at the pipeline's 300-dpi page render - above the ~300 px threshold at which the phantom I/[HH] artifact appears. Accepted with the caveat recorded rather than assumed away

Also 5.12 MB

'Advances in Catalysis Using N-Heterocyclic Carbene Platinum Complexes', Molecules 2025, CC BY. Sought as a true M-C organometallic. Rejected on length and size: 39 pages and 7.41 MB, i.e. 30% of the addition budget, for complexes that are novel and so not PubChem-resolvable

Weil et al., 'Two (methylsulfanyl)benzyl-derivatized palladium-N-heterocyclic carbene complexes', Acta Cryst. 2026, E82, 426-431, CC BY 4.0. Sought as a true M-C organometallic. Rejected on CONTENT: the only 2D drawing in the paper is a GENERIC formula, X-Pd-X with 'X = Cl, Br' printed beneath it - a Markush by another name, selection rule 1. The remaining figures are 3D ORTEP displacement-ellipsoid plots and packing diagrams. Also 19 pages / 4.98 MB. Noted for round 4: an Acta Cryst E paper whose 2D scheme is specific would be an excellent ORTEP-based hard negative
